concept: Cost Explorer + Budgets: spend analysis and forecast-based alerts
tests: Which services provide spend visualization, custom budgets and alerts on forecasted overruns.
expected: AWS Cost Explorer — spending trends and analysis; AWS Budgets — budgets with alerts on actual and forecasted costs. Triggers: "visibility into spending", "custom budgets", "forecasted costs exceed thresholds".
why_not: CloudWatch — operational metrics, not budgets; CloudTrail — API activity; Config — configuration compliance.
